ated_time, agent_user_id

agent_user_id,
 COUNT(DISTINCT action_annotation_id) AS hint_sent_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS convo_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT agent_user_id) AS user_count FROM action_annotation_d 
 WHERE action_type in (1,6,13,14) -- 1: regular+behavioral hint, 6: manager alert, 13: GW hint, 14: KB hint
 AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
 AND policy_source_type=1

 ),

e_action_adherence_type = ?)) -- Additional filters

 AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (action_type = ?) AND (action_adherence_type = ?)) -- Additional filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 )

ated_time, agent_user_id

agent_user_id,
 COUNT(DISTINCT action_annotation_id) AS hint_sent_count,

 COUNT(DISTINCT agent_user_id) AS user_count FROM action_annotation_d

 AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)

 ),
 combined_hint_sent AS (

e_action_adherence_type = ?)) -- Additional filters

 AND agent_user_id <> ''
 AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (action_type = ?) AND (action_adherence_type = ?)) -- Additional filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 )
 SELECT
 truncated_time,
agent_user_id,

 MAX(combined_hint_sent.user_coun

t) AS user_count,

 WITH

 -- behavioral hint

agent_user_id,

 COUNT(DISTINCT agent_user_id) AS user_count FROM action_annotation_d

 FROM moment_annotation_d

 )
 AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
 AND policy_source_type = 1
 AND is_dev_user = 0
 AND agent_user_id <> ''
 AND ((conver

sation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (action_type = ?) AND (adherence_type = ?)) -- Additional filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 UNION ALL
 -- non-behavior hint.
 SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(0)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(0) AS truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
 COUNT(DISTINCT action_annotation_id) AS hint_sent_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS convo_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT agent_user_id) AS user_count FROM action_annotation_d 
 WHERE action_type in (1,6,13,14) -- 1: regular+behavioral hint, 6: manager alert, 13: GW hint, 14: KB hint
 AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
 AND policy_source_type=1
 AND is_dev_user = 0
 AND agent_user_id <> ''
 AND adherence_type = 0
 AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (action_type = ?) AND (adherence_type = ?)) -- Additional filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 ),
 c

ombined_hint_sent AS (
 SELECT
 truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
 -- Here max rather than sum is used because hint_sent already combines behavioral and non-behavioral hints in one single row.
 MAX(hint_sent.convo_count) AS convo_count,
 MAX(hint_sent.user_count) AS user_count,
 MAX(hint_sent.hint_sent_count) AS hint_sent_count
 FROM hint_sent
 GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 ),
 -- hint_followed_count
 hint_followed AS(
 -- behavioral hint followed including checklist hint.
 SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(0)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(0) AS truncated_time,
agent_user_id,COUNT(DISTINCT adherence_action_annotation_id) AS hint_followed_count FROM moment_annotation_d 
 
 WHERE adherence_type = 2

 AND adherence_action_policy_source_type=1 -- TODO: add policy_source_type into moment_annotation table
 AND is_dev_user =

0
 AND agent_user_id <> ''
 AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (adherence_action_type = ?) AND (adherence_action_adherence_type = ?)) -- Additional filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 UNION ALL
 -- GW|KB hint followed
 SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(0)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(0) AS truncated_time,
agent_user_id,COUNT(DISTINCT action_annotation_id) as hint_followed_count FROM conversation_event_d 
 
 WHERE event_type = 9
 AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
 AND action_policy_source_type=1
 AND is_dev_user = 0
 AND agent_user_id <> ''
 AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (action_type = ?) AND (action_adherence_type = ?)) -- Additional filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 )
 SELECT
 truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
 -- Here max rather than sum is used because combined_hint_sent already combin

es behavioral and non-behavioral hints in one single row.
 MAX(combined_hint_sent.convo_count) AS convo_count,
 MAX(combined_hint_sent.user_count) AS user_count,
 MAX(combined_hint_sent.hint_sent_count) AS hint_sent_count,
 SUM(hint_followed.hint_followed_count) AS hint_followed_count
 FROM combined_hint_sent
 LEFT JOIN hint_followed USING (truncated_time, agent_user_id)
 GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id"}

{"level":"info","ts":1792428495.6582458,"caller":"analyticsimpl/retrieve_hint_stats_clickhouse.go:146","message":"clickhouse query: 
 WITH
 
 
 hint_sent AS (
 -- behavioral hint
 SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(0)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(0) AS truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
 COUNT(DISTINCT action_annotation_id) AS hint_sent_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS convo_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT agent_user_id) AS user_count FROM action_annotation_d 
 WHERE action_annotation_id GLOBAL IN (
 SELECT adherence_action_annotation_id
 FROM moment_annotation_d
 WHERE adherence_type IN (2, 3)
 AND adherence_action_annotation_id <> ''
 AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (adherence_action_type = ?) AND (adherence_action_adherence_type = ?))
 )
 AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
 AND policy_source_type = 1
 AND is_dev_user = 0
 AND agent_user_id <> ''
 AND ((conve

rsation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (action_type = ?) AND (adherence_type = ?)) -- Additional filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 UNION ALL
 -- non-behavior hint.
 SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(0)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(0) AS truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
 COUNT(DISTINCT action_annotation_id) AS hint_sent_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS convo_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT agent_user_id) AS user_count FROM action_annotation_d 
 WHERE action_type in (1,6,13,14) -- 1: regular+behavioral hint, 6: manager alert, 13: GW hint, 14: KB hint
 AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
 AND policy_source_type=1
 AND is_dev_user = 0
 AND agent_user_id <> ''
 AND adherence_type = 0
 AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (action_type = ?) AND (adherence_type = ?)) -- Additional filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 ),

combined_hint_sent AS (
 SELECT
 truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
 -- Here max rather than sum is used because hint_sent already combines behavioral and non-behavioral hints in one single row.
 MAX(hint_sent.convo_count) AS convo_count,
 MAX(hint_sent.user_count) AS user_count,
 MAX(hint_sent.hint_sent_count) AS hint_sent_count
 FROM hint_sent
 GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 ),
 -- hint_followed_count
 hint_followed AS(
 -- behavioral hint followed including checklist hint.
 SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(0)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(0) AS truncated_time,
agent_user_id,COUNT(DISTINCT adherence_action_annotation_id) AS hint_followed_count FROM moment_annotation_d 
 
 WHERE adherence_type = 2
 AND adherence_action_annotation_id <> ''
 AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
 AND adherence_action_policy_source_type=1 -- TODO: add policy_source_type into moment_annotation table
 AND is_dev_user

= 0
 AND agent_user_id <> ''
 AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (adherence_action_type = ?) AND (adherence_action_adherence_type = ?)) -- Additional filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 UNION ALL
 -- GW|KB hint followed
 SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(0)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(0) AS truncated_time,
agent_user_id,COUNT(DISTINCT action_annotation_id) as hint_followed_count FROM conversation_event_d 
 
 WHERE event_type = 9
 AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
 AND action_policy_source_type=1
 AND is_dev_user = 0
 AND agent_user_id <> ''
 AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (action_type = ?) AND (action_adherence_type = ?)) -- Additional filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 )
 SELECT
 truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
 -- Here max rather than sum is used because combined_hint_sent already combi

nes behavioral and non-behavioral hints in one single row.
 MAX(combined_hint_sent.convo_count) AS convo_count,
 MAX(combined_hint_sent.user_count) AS user_count,
 MAX(combined_hint_sent.hint_sent_count) AS hint_sent_count,
 SUM(hint_followed.hint_followed_count) AS hint_followed_count
 FROM combined_hint_sent
 LEFT JOIN hint_followed USING (truncated_time, agent_user_id)
 GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id"}

{"level":"info","ts":1792428566.2848809,"caller":"analyticsimpl/retrieve_hint_stats_clickhouse.go:146","message":"clickhouse query: 
 WITH
 
 
 hint_sent AS (
 -- behavioral hint
 SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(0)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(0) AS truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
 COUNT(DISTINCT action_annotation_id) AS hint_sent_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS convo_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT agent_user_id) AS user_count FROM action_annotation_d 
 WHERE action_annotation_id GLOBAL IN (
 SELECT adherence_action_annotation_id
 FROM moment_annotation_d
 WHERE adherence_type IN (2, 3)
 AND adherence_action_annotation_id <> ''
 AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?))
 )
 AND (conversation_source in (0, 8, 7) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
 AND policy_source_type = 1
 AND is_dev_user = 0
 AND agent_user_id <> ''
 AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Addition

al filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 UNION ALL
 -- non-behavior hint.
 SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(0)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(0) AS truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
 COUNT(DISTINCT action_annotation_id) AS hint_sent_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS convo_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT agent_user_id) AS user_count FROM action_annotation_d 
 WHERE action_type in (1,6,13,14) -- 1: regular+behavioral hint, 6: manager alert, 13: GW hint, 14: KB hint
 AND (conversation_source in (0, 8, 7) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
 AND policy_source_type=1
 AND is_dev_user = 0
 AND agent_user_id <> ''
 AND adherence_type = 0
 AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Additional filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 ),
 combined_hint_sent AS (
 SELECT
 truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
 -- Here max rather than sum is used because hint_sent already combines behavioral and non-beh

avioral hints in one single row.
 MAX(hint_sent.convo_count) AS convo_count,
 MAX(hint_sent.user_count) AS user_count,
 MAX(hint_sent.hint_sent_count) AS hint_sent_count
 FROM hint_sent
 GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 ),
 -- hint_followed_count
 hint_followed AS(
 -- behavioral hint followed including checklist hint.
 SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(0)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(0) AS truncated_time,
agent_user_id,COUNT(DISTINCT adherence_action_annotation_id) AS hint_followed_count FROM moment_annotation_d 
 
 WHERE adherence_type = 2
 AND adherence_action_annotation_id <> ''
 AND (conversation_source in (0, 8, 7) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
 AND adherence_action_policy_source_type=1 -- TODO: add policy_source_type into moment_annotation table
 AND is_dev_user = 0
 AND agent_user_id <> ''
 AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Additional filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent

_user_id
 UNION ALL
 -- GW|KB hint followed
 SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(0)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(0) AS truncated_time,
agent_user_id,COUNT(DISTINCT action_annotation_id) as hint_followed_count FROM conversation_event_d 
 
 WHERE event_type = 9
 AND (conversation_source in (0, 8, 7) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
 AND action_policy_source_type=1
 AND is_dev_user = 0
 AND agent_user_id <> ''
 AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Additional filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 )
 SELECT
 truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
 -- Here max rather than sum is used because combined_hint_sent already combines behavioral and non-behavioral hints in one single row.
 MAX(combined_hint_sent.convo_count) AS convo_count,
 MAX(combined_hint_sent.user_count) AS user_count,
 MAX(combined_hint_sent.hint_sent_count) AS hint_sent_count,
 SUM(hint_followed.hint_followed_count) AS hint_followed

_count
 FROM combined_hint_sent
 LEFT JOIN hint_followed USING (truncated_time, agent_user_id)
 GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id"}

 )

e >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (agent_user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM agent_filter))) -- Additional filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 UNION ALL
 -- non-behavior hint.
 SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(0)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(0) AS truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
 COUNT(DISTINCT action_annotation_id) AS hint_sent_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS convo_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT agent_user_id) AS user_count FROM action_annotation_d 
 WHERE action_type in (1,6,13,14) -- 1: regular+behavioral hint, 6: manager alert, 13: GW hint, 14: KB hint
 AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
 AND policy_source_type=1
 AND is_dev_user = 0
 AND agent_user_id <> ''
 AND adherence_type = 0
 AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (agent_user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM agent_filter))) -- Additional filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id

),
 combined_hint_sent AS (
 SELECT
 truncated_time,
agent_user_id,

 MAX(hint_sent.convo_count) AS convo_count,

 MAX(hint_sent.hint_sent_count) AS hint_sent_count
 FROM hint_sent

 ),
 -- hint_followed_count

 AND is_dev_

user = 0
 AND agent_user_id <> ''
 AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (agent_user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM agent_filter))) -- Additional filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 UNION ALL
 -- GW|KB hint followed
 SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', conversation_start_time + toIntervalDay(0) + toIntervalHour(0)) - toIntervalDay(0) - toIntervalHour(0) AS truncated_time,
agent_user_id,COUNT(DISTINCT action_annotation_id) as hint_followed_count FROM conversation_event_d 
 
 WHERE event_type = 9
 AND (conversation_source in (0, 8) OR conversation_source IS NULL)
 AND action_policy_source_type=1
 AND is_dev_user = 0
 AND agent_user_id <> ''
 AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?) AND (agent_user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM agent_filter))) -- Additional filters
 
GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id
 )
 SELECT
 truncated_time,
agent_user_id,
 -- Here max rather than sum is used because combined_hint_sent already combines beh

avioral and non-behavioral hints in one single row.
 MAX(combined_hint_sent.convo_count) AS convo_count,
 MAX(combined_hint_sent.user_count) AS user_count,
 MAX(combined_hint_sent.hint_sent_count) AS hint_sent_count,
 SUM(hint_followed.hint_followed_count) AS hint_followed_count
 FROM combined_hint_sent
 LEFT JOIN hint_followed USING (truncated_time, agent_user_id)
 GROUP BY truncated_time, agent_user_id"}
